block.temporalindustries.chronovault.too:
Tracks this chunk's history.
Roll it back or jump it forward
from its own timeline.
Mode: Rewind, Keep Inventory (1,000 mB ORD)

"Return by Death!"
Right-click to set an anchor point.
Death rewinds you to that point in time.
Sneak + scroll to change mode.
temporalindustries.anchor.reverted.title: Paradox Averted
Insert a saved Echo Record to loop it
as a translucent ghost, consuming energy.
Right-click empty-handed to remove it.
Echo Record has no saved recording
item.temporalindustries.echo_record.limi: Recording length limit reached - saved automatically
item.temporalindustries.echo_record.tool: Right-click to start recording your movements.
death.attack.temporalindustries.chrono_e: %1$s was struck down by an echo of the past
item.temporalindustries.echo_record.clea: Sneak and right-click to clear the saved recording
block.temporalindustries.chronodial.tool:
Single-block time marker.
Sneak + right-click to set a marker.
Right-click to restore it, spending energy.
block.temporalindustries.chronosphere.to:
Multi-chunk time machine.
Claims up to an 11x11 area of chunks,
jumping them together from a shared energy pool.
block.temporalindustries.chronosphere.ou: That chunk is outside the claimable range
block.temporalindustries.chronosphere.al: That chunk is already claimed by another machine
block.temporalindustries.chronosphere.li: This Chronosphere has claimed the maximum number of chunks
gui.temporalindustries.chronosphere.map_: Click a chunk to claim or release it
Erases every tracked chunk's recorded history. The world itself is left exactly as it is.
This cannot be undone. Are you sure?
item.temporalindustries.portable_chrono_: Right-click to record a save point in the surrounding area.
Captures a chunk radius around you when marked.
Sneak + right-click to choose exactly which chunks to capture.
gui.temporalindustries.chrono_marker.map: Click a chunk to add or remove it
item.temporalindustries.temporal_glue.co: First corner set - right-click the opposite corner to glue
item.temporalindustries.temporal_glue.to:
Right-click two corners to glue an area.
All blocks in this area are unaffected by time travel.
Left-click a glued area to remove it.
First corner set - right-click to place the second
item.temporalindustries.schrodinger_gene:
Right-click a mob to trap it inside.
Generates Order and Chaos over time (50/50 odds).
Landing on Order also pulses out FE.
block.temporalindustries.seebeck_generat:
Passive FE generator.
Place with a hot block to its left
and a cold block to its right.
item.temporalindustries.cell.tooltip:
Catches Order/Chaos orbs and condenses them.
Right-click a machine to pour liquid into it.
Sneak + scroll to change how much per pour.
block.temporalindustries.entropy_condens:
Absorbs Order/Chaos entropy orbs in front of it,
condensing them into liquid Order/Chaos.
block.temporalindustries.crude_entropy_c:
Unpowered lower tier of the Entropy Condenser.
Slowly drains an Order/Chaos Cell in its
input slot into liquid Order/Chaos.
block.temporalindustries.entropy_manipul: Transmutes items into the next item in a given entropy chain.
Shows entropy info about the block you're looking at.
